additionalSarifResult.reason: 32 unique alphabet symbols divide 256 exactly. Each output symbol has eight byte preimages; eight uniform crypto.randomBytes give 40 bits. P12/P17/P23 finite proof tied to real source plus P12/P21 real crypto/verification/single-use-store tests. This is NOT a claim that 40 bits alone provides unlimited online/offline security or that a new GitHub regression was introduced.
